install: if [ ! -x "$HOME/.bun/bin/bun" ]; then curl -fsSL https://bun.sh/install | BUN_INSTALL="$HOME/.bun" bash; fi; (sed -i '/case \$- in/,/esac/d' "$HOME/.bashrc" 2>/dev/null || true); grep -qxF 'export BUN_INSTALL="$HOME/.bun"' "$HOME/.bashrc" || echo 'export BUN_INSTALL="$HOME/.bun"' >> "$HOME/.bashrc"; grep -qxF 'export PATH="$HOME/.bun/bin:$PATH"' "$HOME/.bashrc" || echo 'export PATH="$HOME/.bun/bin:$PATH"' >> "$HOME/.bashrc"; export BUN_INSTALL="$HOME/.bun" PATH="$HOME/.bun/bin:$PATH"; bun install --no-save
